summary: Sloping arterial kerb with apartments and houses close and no parked cars.

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks at 7-8 m and houses at 11 m bracket this stretch; dwellings 18 m away at best.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb of a through road; no cars parked and no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with a junction at the west end.
drivers.convention: One no parking any time sign nearby; no overnight parking seen.

flags: Slope rises about 2.5 m over the stretch, up to 5.6% in places
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy shades the north kerb from the north and east.

best_section.where: north kerb of Sir Fred Schonell Drive under the trees, west of the house cluster
